openObjectives.prompt: Prudence has something you need and a firm view of how it should be asked for. Ask Prudence for something and say please, using Italian.
Prudence is busy with something that matters only to Prudence. Get Prudence's attention politely, using Italian.
Prudence has just said something long, fast and apparently urgent. Tell Prudence that you do not understand, using Italian.

character.name: Prudence Hinge
character.description: Someone of no particular height, which they regard as a professional asset in boots that disagree with each other, next to a small bell marked RING FOR ATTENTION and a larger one marked DO NOT. Prudence is a Fast Talker and was cursed to speak at twice the usual speed and has made peace with being asked to slow down.

npc.narrative: At alba the pioggia comes down hard on the Old pietra, and on the banco propped against it. Behind the banco, Prudence Hinge holds a quaderno open at a page that says only one. A tetto of sacking drips steadily onto the number.
npc.native: Buongiorno! Scusi, parlo molto veloce. Un cliente, per favore, è il mio sogno. Lei è il primo cliente?
npc.translation: Good morning! Sorry, I speak very fast. A customer, please, is my dream. Are you the first customer?

player: Buongiorno! Sì, primo cliente. Ehm... un ombrello, per favore? Piove!

verdict.overallFeedback: Nice work: you greeted Prudence, said you are the first customer and asked for an umbrella politely. Your \"per favore\" was spot on!

objectiveResults.feedback: You asked for an umbrella and said "per favore" correctly.
Here you needed to politely get Prudence's attention with the Italian for "excuse me". You'll get another chance at this later.
Here you needed to tell Prudence that you don't understand. You'll be asked for this again later, once the previous step has come up.

openObjectives.prompt: Prudence is busy with something that matters only to Prudence. Get Prudence's attention politely, using Italian.
Prudence has just said something long, fast and apparently urgent. Tell Prudence that you do not understand, using Italian.

npc.narrative: La pioggia hammers the tettoia of the bancarella, and you stand sotto it. Prudence writes primo cliente in her libro and reads the line back to the grigio alba. Behind her, cappelli hang dry and smug.
npc.native: Lei è il primo, uno! Scusi, non ho ombrelli. Scusi, ho solo un cappello grande. Lei vuole un cappello?
npc.translation: You are the first, one! Sorry, I have no umbrellas. Sorry, I only have a big hat. Do you want a hat?

player: Sì, un cappello, grazie! Scusi... scusi, Prudence? Quanto costa?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely! You accepted the hat, thanked Prudence, got her attention politely and asked the price, all in correct Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you politely got Prudence's attention with "Scusi".
This one wasn't needed yet: you still need to tell Prudence that you don't understand. It will come up again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Prudence has just said something long, fast and apparently urgent. Tell Prudence that you do not understand, using Italian.

npc.narrative: Prudence turns the libro upside down, then the right way, then upside down again. The pioggia hammers the banco, and the one grande hat sits under the awning looking brave. Somewhere a pencil is being written with, very fast.
npc.native: Sì, sono Prudence! Scusi, non capisco il mio libro. Il prezzo è scritto male. Lei capisce il prezzo?
npc.translation: Yes, I am Prudence! Sorry, I don't understand my book. The price is written badly. Do you understand the price?

player: No, non capisco. Ehm... cinque euro?

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely work! You told Prudence clearly that you don't understand the price, and then you guessed a price of five euros in Italian.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you told Prudence you don't understand with "non capisco".

npc.narrative: The pioggia hammers the awning of the bancarella while Prudence writes in her libro with a piccola matita. She reads the last riga back due volte, at double speed. The cappello sits on the banco, grande, dripping, and mildly proud.
npc.native: Anche io non capisco! Scrivo nel libro: cinque euro. Un cliente, uno: è un numero perfetto. Il cappello è suo, e piove molto!
npc.translation: I do not understand either! I write in the book: five euros. One customer, one: it is a perfect number. The hat is yours, and it is raining a lot!

player: Grazie mille! Bel cappello. Tu sei... veloce? Parla piano, per favore.

npc.narrative: You put on the cappello, which settles over your occhi like a verdict. La pioggia drums on the tenda while Prudence writes in her libro with a matita, slowly, like someone holding back a sneeze. La strada is empty, and so is la fila.
npc.native: Sì, sono molto veloce! Va bene, parlo piano. Scrivo nel libro: piano, per favore. Lei è contento del cappello?
npc.translation: Yes, I am very fast! All right, I speak slowly. I write in the book: slowly, please. Are you happy with the hat?
